content:
Grouping follows the Rate Select table (64GFC / 32GFC / 16GFC) and each rate’s optical section. `post_fec_ber_target` is not stated in the excerpt, so it is omitted. LOS Assert is specified as −30 to −17 dBm on all three rates; `los_assert_dbm` uses −17.0 (assert threshold). Unstressed receiver sensitivity is used for `rx_sensitivity_dbm`.

```json
{
  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "64GFC PAM4",
      "standards_code": "64GFC",
      "baud_rate_gbaud": 28.9,
      "bit_rate_gbps": 64.0,
      "modulation_format": "PAM4",
      "tx_power_min_dbm": -7.5,
      "tx_power_max_dbm": 4.0,
      "rx_sensitivity_dbm": -7.0,
      "rx_overload_dbm": 4.0,
      "los_assert_dbm": -17.0
    },
    {
      "label": "32GFC NRZ",
      "standards_code": "32GFC",
      "baud_rate_gbaud": 28.05,
      "bit_rate_gbps": 32.0,
      "modulation_format": "NRZ",
      "tx_power_min_dbm": -6.2,
      "tx_power_max_dbm": 2.0,
      "rx_sensitivity_dbm": -10.2,
      "rx_overload_dbm": 2.0,
      "los_assert_dbm": -17.0
    },
    {
      "label": "16GFC NRZ",
      "standards_code": "16GFC",
      "baud_rate_gbaud": 14.025,
      "bit_rate_gbps": 16.0,
      "modulation_format": "NRZ",
      "tx_power_min_dbm": -7.8,
      "tx_power_max_dbm": 0.0,
      "rx_sensitivity_dbm": -10.5,
      "rx_overload_dbm": 0.0,
      "los_assert_dbm": -17.0
    }
  ]
}
```
